edits.statement: Merge headers and multiValueHeaders; multi-value entries take precedence and every output value is a comma-and-space joined string.
Return a new mapping with every string key title-cased and values unchanged.
Return the lowercase hexadecimal MD5 digest of the UTF-8 encoded text.
Lowercase the name, remove characters other than word characters, whitespace, and hyphens, collapse whitespace or underscores to one underscore, then trim leading and trailing dashes or underscores.
Parse major, optional minor, and optional trailing revision from a version string and return a JSON list of three integers; return [0, 0, 0] when parsing fails.
Convert the value to an integer and return zero on any conversion failure.
Apply old-style percent formatting with args when args is non-empty; otherwise return the message unchanged.
Convert case-insensitive true/false to booleans, null to None, integer text to int, floating-point text to float, and otherwise preserve the string.

For mode ip return the user IP; for hostname return the hostname; otherwise append the dot-trimmed domain unless the hostname already equals or ends with it, case-insensitively; return None when hostname is absent.

Return true only when device MAC, neighbor local port, and chassis ID are valid and a case-insensitive matching client record exists in wired_clients, represented as records with switch_mac, switch_port, and client_macs.
Return a sorted JSON list of all unique POSIX parent paths for every absolute input path, including the root.
Case-insensitively map yes, y, true, t, and 1 to true; map no, n, false, f, and 0 to false.
Parse one float as a number or exactly two comma-separated floats as a JSON list.
Return nbytes/1000000 plus ' MB' above 2000000 bytes, nbytes/1000 plus ' kB' for other positive values, and '0 B' for zero or negative values.
Extract one capitalized chemical symbol with an optional lowercase letter from each type string and return the symbols in order when their count matches labels.

Prefer a consistent numeric space-group value from symmetry_params then sg_params and return it as an integer; otherwise normalize spaces in Hermann-Mauguin notation and resolve it through hm_groups, falling back to the notation.
